rows.Name: identifier, do not change
rows.OutputPathIds: if empty parameter is calculated for all simulated outputs, otherwise specify comma separated

rows.LongName: long name used in figure caption or as "Report name"  in electronic package tables
rows.ShortName: short name used as label in plots

rows.Shape: shape for plots (optional; if specified, all rows must have a value). See vignette for available shapes.

rows.DisplayName: display name in legend and captions
rows.Color: plot color (optional; if specified, all rows must have a value)
rows.Fill: plot fill color (optional; if specified, all rows must have a value)

rows.DisplayName: name used for legend and captions

rows.PlotName: all rows with same PlotName are grouped; may be split into facets
rows.OutputPathIds: outputs plotted in same panel (comma-separated from Outputs)
rows.IndividualIds: individual IDs to plot (leave empty for all)
rows.plotCaptionAddon: text to append to figure caption
rows.SplitPlotsPerTimeRange: separate plot per time range (1/TRUE) or panels in one plot (0/FALSE)
rows.ylimit_linear: y-axis limits for linear scale (e.g., c(0, NA))
rows.ylimit_log: y-axis limits for log scale (e.g., c(0.1, NA))
rows.Plot_PredictedVsObserved: generate predicted vs. observed plots (1/TRUE or 0/FALSE)
rows.FoldDistance_PvO: fold distance factor for reference line in predicted vs. observed plots (numeric)
rows.Plot_ResidualsVsTime: generate residuals vs. time plots (1/TRUE or 0/FALSE)
rows.Plot_ResidualsVsObserved: generate residuals vs. observed plots (1/TRUE or 0/FALSE)

rows.TimeShift: time shift: numeric value or empty (defaults to range minimum)
